assumptions.reason: The specification states that longcondition logic is pre-calculated but not explicitly defined; a 20-period SMA close filter provides a simple, standard boolean main market signal.

assumptions.choice: Mapped close[1] to self.data.close[-1] (the closing price of the previous bar).
assumptions.reason: The notation close[1] originates from Pine Script convention where square brackets denote historical offset (1 bar ago).

assumptions.choice: Stored order.executed.price upon sell order completion in notify_order.
assumptions.reason: order.executed.price provides the exact trade execution price at which the previous long position was closed.
The spec requests using 100% of available capital per trade; accounting for the 0.001 commission rate prevents order rejection due to insufficient margin/cash.
